waves.name: Wave 1 — the base
waves.why: Nothing could be checked until the promises and the guard existed.

waves.name: Wave 2 — the first surfaces
waves.why: With the promises in place, the app and the checks could be built against them.

waves.name: Waves 3 to 6 — the ratchet
waves.why: Every promise had to be judged against the real repository, in both directions, before anything new was added.

the checks aimed at the running app

waves.name: Wave 7 — the experience
waves.why: Your decisions about the app become promises now, and the shape is proved while they are written.

waves.why: Waiting on your notes about the live session connector. Everything else in this wave can start without you.
